title: Round 4: only the number two (שְׁתַּיִם, shTA-yim). Round 3 was approved on 2026-11-01 except this word; five respellings for the voice only, screen text unchanged.
note: Written by the voice-and-sound-director on 2026-11-01. Model eleven_v4_turbo (not changed), stability 0.5, similarity 0.8, as N18. Candidates A to E change only the letters sent to the voice; the screen text stays שתיים/שְׁתַּיִם. If one wins it becomes a voices.json pronunciation entry (the plain and the pointed form both map to it). None is certain: no ElevenLabs document describes Hebrew stress control, so this round is the test.

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שתאים שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: Candidate A, no points at all, an aleph for the glottal break (שתאים). Listen: shTA-im with stress on TA. Unpointed words can lean on the model's own guess; does it still land on TA?

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שְׁתַּיְיִם שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: Candidate B, a doubled yod with a sheva (U+05B0) so the diphthong is kept apart: shTAY-yim. Listen: TA-yim stressed on TA, no extra "y" sound or stutter.

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שְׁתַּאיִם שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: Candidate C, an aleph as a glottal break (the owner's idea): shTA-im. Listen: TA stressed, a clean break before "im"; a gap or a "ta-ee-im" is a fail.

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שתַּיִם שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: Candidate D, nikud only on the TA (the community advice: sparse points): sh-TA-yim. Listen: does dropping the sheva and the long ending make the stress land on TA?

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שְׁתַּיִים שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: Candidate E, the full spelling with two yods and a hirik under the first (שְׁתַּיִים): shTA-yim. Listen: stress on TA, not on YIM.
Candidate A alone, one word, a full stop: the cleanest hearing of the stress (shTA-yim). Judge the stress, not the tone.
Candidate C alone, one word: shTA-im or shTA-yim? Same question as N31-iso-A.
Candidate C at the start of a sentence (the N19 position, where the model also misread it). Only useful if C or B wins N30; shTA-yim at the head of the line.
Control, unchanged spelling: שְׁתֵּי 'shte' (two, before a noun) and בַּשָּׁמַיִם. The owner approved the others; confirm שְׁתֵּי is not misread the same way.

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שתאים שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: hero-son, candidate A (שתאים, unpointed) in the N18 sentence: shTA-yim. Compare with H06 (old).

clips.text: כן, שֵׁשׁ ועוד שְׁתַּאיִם שָׁוֶה שְׁמוֹנֶה.
clips.tests: hero-son, candidate C in the N18 sentence: shTA-yim, no gap.
